title: Safety under the halting action
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration of a machine over the folded alphabet, and suppose $c$ satisfies the safety invariant: its state is not the fresh initial state, all work-head positions are nonnegative, and each nonnegative tape cell has its origin flag set exactly at position $0$. Applying the stationary halting action to $c$ yields a configuration satisfying the same invariant.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a configuration over the folded alphabet
replaced:
If a configuration of a $k$-work-tape machine over the folded alphabet, on an
arbitrary folded-alphabet input, satisfies the safety invariant, then so does the
configuration obtained from it by applying the stationary halting action.
